summary: Run detail now has an interactive Yahoo daily-close chart with catalog bear/base/bull overlay and range buttons (1M–MAX). History is GET /api/price-history; FV still comes only from catalog. Strategic design review applied: price-primary Y scale, no live vs-base percent, stale range ignored, failures not cached, one range allowlist.
follow_ups: Ticker-level chart on the runs list when a single ticker is filtered
risks: Yahoo history can fail or lag for some listings; chart still draws catalog levels
Unstamped sessions use folder ticker as quote_listing (same as Live column)
